# Border Color

::: info 实现进度 55% · 进行中
Playground 已 `@source` 文档 markdown，这些类名可在本页示例里跑。未写入 `helpers.css`；SDK 里 schema 动态 class 仍依赖源码扫描。`m:` / `pc:` 只接到间距和宽高。
:::

边框色。配合 `border` 使用。

```schema
type: page
body:
  - type: tpl
    className: border border-border p-sm rounded-md
    tpl: border-border
  - type: tpl
    className: border border-primary p-sm rounded-md m-t-sm
    tpl: border-primary
  - type: tpl
    className: border-2 border-blue-500 p-sm rounded-md m-t-sm
    tpl: border-blue-500
```

## 类名

| Class | Properties |
| --- | --- |
| `border-border` | `默认线色` |
| `border-input` | `输入框线` |
| `border-primary` | `主色` |
| `border-destructive` | `危险` |
| `border-blue-500` | `调色盘` |

响应式：`m:` / `pc:` 目前只接到间距和宽高辅助类。其它类请用 Tailwind 断点（`max-md:` / `md:`）。状态前缀见 [辅助类-状态样式](/style/state)。
